title: Nice piece and very reasonably priced.
text: Nice piece and very reasonably priced.. I purchased this skeleton key for my daughter-in-law, and she just loved it.  Recently I purchased 2 sets of keys from someone else, and they were as nice as this one, but they were very expensive.  I'm sorry I didn't get a few of these for myself.  It is larger than I pictured it, and a nice heavy quality.
